name: dsh-qwen38-llamacpp-compaction-fix
description: DSH plugin (llama.cpp gateways, e.g. Unsloth Studio): local qwen3.8-27b compaction fix — thinking off for compaction-only calls with the model's non-thinking sampling parameters and a max_tokens floor; plus a chunked map-reduce rescue when the conversation is larger than the target model's context window (the 1M->250k model-switch 'cannot compact' case)
